description: Get the full details of a single Substack post by URL, including title, author, publication, publish date, body text, like count, comment count, and restack count. Optionally fetch the comment list with --include_comments. Uses Substack's internal post API and falls back to DOM extraction if needed.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The full URL of the Substack post, e.g. https://bettermarkets.substack.com/p/jamie-dimon-and-better-markets-agree

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: When 'true', also fetch and return the post's comment list from /p/<slug>/comments. Defaults to 'false'.
